# Dr. Akshay Parmar, DDS, FACP, FAAMP — Prosthodontist, Hamilton Township, NJ

> Board-certified prosthodontist providing dental implants, immediate implant
> surgery, full-arch (All-on-X) rehabilitation, full mouth reconstruction,
> porcelain veneers, and maxillofacial prosthetic rehabilitation (including
> care after head and neck cancer surgery) in Hamilton Township, New Jersey.
> Serving Mercer County, Princeton, Trenton, Robbinsville, Lawrenceville and
> the wider region. Office: 1544 Kuser Rd, Suite C3, Hamilton Township, NJ
> 08619. Phone: (609) 585-1616. Hours: Monday–Friday 10:00–17:00.

Dr. Parmar holds BDS, DDS, MDSc degrees, is a Diplomate of the American Board
of Prosthodontics, a Fellow of the American College of Prosthodontists (FACP)
and of the American Academy of Maxillofacial Prosthetics (FAAMP), trained at
Memorial Sloan Kettering Cancer Center, and teaches implant surgery and
prosthodontics internationally.

## Services
- [Dental implants](https://drparmardds.com/dental-implants-new-jersey): single and multiple implants, placed and restored by a specialist
- [Full-arch implants / All-on-X](https://drparmardds.com/full-arch-implants-new-jersey): fixed full-arch rehabilitation for failing or missing teeth
- [Immediate implants](https://drparmardds.com/immediate-implant-rehabilitation): implant placement with same-day provisional teeth
- [Full mouth reconstruction](https://drparmardds.com/aesthetic-dentistry): rebuilding a failing dentition as one coordinated plan
- [Worn teeth and bite reconstruction](https://drparmardds.com/tooth-wear-rehabilitation): restoring lost vertical dimension
- [Porcelain veneers](https://drparmardds.com/veneers-aesthetic-reconstruction): conservative specialist veneers and smile design
- [Maxillofacial prosthodontics](https://drparmardds.com/maxillofacial-rehabilitation): obturators and rehabilitation after oral cancer surgery
- [Teeth whitening](https://drparmardds.com/teeth-whitening): specialist-supervised whitening
